title: Hygiene Kit Distribution
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End organised a Hygiene Kit Distribution Programme on 20th October 2026 at Kaifi Azmi Park, Juhu, distributing 200 hygiene kits to BMC workers as part of its community service initiative.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End organised a Hygiene Kit Distribution Programme on 20th October 2026 at Kaifi Azmi Park, Juhu, distributing 200 hygiene kits to BMC workers as part of its community service initiative. The programme was supported by generous sponsor Rtn. Vijay Bankda and Asha Ji, with the presence of Corporators Ms. Sudha Singh and Mr. Deepak Kothekar. This special Dussehra initiative was a gesture of gratitude and care towards the dedicated workers who keep our city clean.
